story:
Amy went to school. [gesture:happy] She saw big blocks. Amy wanted to build. [emotion:QT/happy] She picked red blocks. She put blocks on the mat. Amy stacked the red blocks. [emotion:QT/happy] She started building a tower.

[emotion:QT/shy] Amy reached high. The tower was tall. But, the blocks are few. She needed more blocks. [emotion:QT/sad] Amy felt little sad. She looked at the pile of blocks. They were blue and yellow.

A friend named Leo sat near. [emotion:QT/calm] Leo saw Amy. Leo said, "Try again." Amy looked at Leo. [emotion:QT/happy] Leo smiled. [emotion:QT/happy] Leo said, "We can build together." Amy pointed at the blocks. Leo picked up some blocks.

[gesture:clapping] They started building. Leo said, "Put the blue blocks on." Amy said, "Stack the big blocks." They worked together. [emotion:QT/happy] The blocks are perfect. They are learning to share.

[emotion:QT/happy] They put the yellow blocks under. They put the red blocks on top. [emotion:QT/happy] The tower is big! It is strong. [emotion:QT/happy] Amy laughed. [emotion:QT/happy] Leo smiled, too. They learned to take turns. They built many blocks today. [emotion:QT/happy] Amy felt so happy.
